description: Start an order to register an available domain for a person. This does not charge anyone. It returns an approval_url that the person must open and pay (in US dollars outside Nigeria, in naira in Nigeria); the name is held for 60 minutes. Send approval_url to your user and wait. Poll get_order_status afterwards.

accept_terms.description: Set true only if your user has agreed to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy on this website.

currency.description: Optional: USD or NGN, the currency the person pays in. By default US dollars outside Nigeria and naira in Nigeria, from where the request comes from.

customer_name.description: Full name of the person who will own the domain.

customer_phone.description: A phone number we can reach, for example 08012345678.

email_verification_token.description: verification_token from verify_email_code for this email (required while email checks are on).

name: create_domain_order
